papers.title: A Multimodal Deep Learning Based Framework for Early and Accurate Diagnosis of Depression Using Electroencephalography and Event‐Related Potential Signals
papers.reason: The paper uses multimodal EEG and ERP features for clinical classification, but targets depression diagnosis without specifically assessing executive function or cognitive impairment.

papers.title: Effects of qigong and resistance exercise on improving balance and cognitive ability of community-dwelling older adults.
papers.reason: The intervention reports changes in global cognition and a MoCA executive-function subdomain in older adults, but provides no process model or detailed executive-function measurements.

papers.title: Dynamic trajectories of inflammatory biomarkers and post-stroke cognitive impairment: a comprehensive review of neuroimmune mechanisms, longitudinal modeling, and clinical translation.
papers.reason: The review concerns biomarker-based prediction of general post-stroke cognitive impairment rather than executive-function mechanisms, computational cognition, or digital assessment.
